title: Chapter 592
paragraphs: Chapter 592
Episode 154. Siblings, and friends
"It's been a while, Jin!"
Veradin shouted cheerfully.
"Hey, our Mr. Jin!"

Sandra, standing next to him, shook her golden prosthetic hand that replaced her right hand, with her mouth full of cookie crumbs. Jin was taken aback for a moment when he saw his own face carved into the golden prosthetic.
"I received your reply to the letter I sent last time! Where did you learn such romantic language?"
"...Reply? Romantic?"
Of course, he had no recollection of sending a reply.
However, Sandra was firmly believing that Jin had given her an answer through some kind of invisible signal.
"You said we should go play at Radin's villa next time."
"No, when did I say that?"
"Wow, Jin. Are you really dating Sandra? So now you're my... brother-in-law!?"
"Radin, how many times do I have to tell you? Not your brother-in-law now, you were never my brother-in-law."
"My friend is my brother-in-law, it feels so!"
"Good?"
"Strange!"
"What's this ruckus in someone else's business place, especially on a holiday?"
As soon as the siblings arrived in Tikan, they found the Litra teahouse. Then they barged into the teahouse saying 'We are Zipfel!' to Ratry, who was announcing that today was a holiday.
Instead, they did pay a huge sum that the Litra teahouse could not earn even if it worked non-stop for a year.
The problem was, the unwelcome guests who were currently forcing the Litra teahouse to open were not just those two.
In the back corner behind the central table occupied by Veradin and Sandra, a person with a hood deeply pulled down was sitting.
'...Valeria!? Why is my master here?'
It was Valeria, who he had met just a few days ago at the Second Star of Hairan. Jin had not heard from Kashmir that she was also at the Litra teahouse.

-You don't have to miss me because you will see me much more often from now on. There's more for us to share, and more for us to help each other with. I plan to use Tikan often to avoid Zipfel's tracking in the future.

At that time, Valeria had clearly said that she would stop by near the territory of the Black Emperor to thank Ron and visit Jeonseungji, but she stopped by the Litra teahouse to take a break. She was tired from dealing with the chaos near the Black Emperor's territory.
Valeria is always a welcome person to Jin. He had found Qwaul much faster than expected and made him his own, so it was about time to get back in touch with Valeria.
However, now was a little difficult. He didn't want to meet both the two pure-blooded Ziphs and her together.
Fortunately, Veradin and Sandra were not showing any curiosity about Valeria sitting in the corner yet.
"Let's go out and talk."
"I like it here! It was my dream to have a cup of tea with Mr. Jin in such a lovely place."
"There's a better... place."
"Where is it?"
"Tikan Kingdom's conference room."
A moment of silence ensued.
"Is it because of that Hister sitting over there?"
Jin was the only one who was shocked at that point.
"Hey, why worry between us. She's wearing a robe, but with red hair and a silver birch cane, can't we, Radin and I, pure-blooded Zipfel, recognize her?"
Valeria already knew that they had recognized her. Her red hair and silver birch cane had been revealed long ago during the long pursuit.
Valeria remained silent because she knew she wouldn't be caught by them. And what Jin worried about was not Valeria being caught, but the opposite.
Jin was more worried that she might kill or capture the two and use them.
To Valeria, Zipfel was a mortal enemy who annihilated her family and massacred the Gray Owl Mercenaries.
'Having heard about the two from me and my colleagues, has she decided to observe?'
Valeria was curious about the two, especially Veradin. Whether he could truly precede Zipfel's purification as the people of Tikan said.
Jin had no choice but to take a seat at the table of the two.
Jin and Veradin's eyes met. An excited Sandra chattered without stopping, and the two were silent for a while.
The last time Jin met Veradin was during the Black Emperor City terrorist attack.
That day, Jin and Dante had asked Veradin for a favor.
They asked him to create a scenario where Zipfel could put pressure on Hairan to clearly distinguish Pia.
A month ago, the result came out.
It was a bitter and sad ending that everyone knew. The royal family chose Zipfel and the White Stone instead of Hairan, as a result, Gliek woke up, and the world was polluted.
Although it was an incident that had to happen even if Veradin did not accept his friends' requests, he was burdened with a heavy guilt as if it were a punishment.
"Have you been well?"
"So-so."
"No, it was tough! Radin, tell him. If you hadn't gone into a rampage, you would've joined the battle in the Black Emperor's Palace with Uncle Kadun and Hedo."
It was anticipated from the battlefield that Veradin would have done something for Dante.
"Rampage? Like the state you were in during the Bentika mission?"
During the mission to assassinate the Black Knight Barton Bichena, Veradin attacked Jin while losing his sanity.
"Similar."
"The magical power you showed then was impressive, but it wasn't enough to suppress without Kadun and Hedo."

"The power was much stronger compared to the Bentika mission. You wouldn't be surprised now, right? I was helpless in the maintenance device just until yesterday. Well, thanks to that, the family can't manipulate my mind for the time being."
Up until now, Zipfel had been manipulating Veradin's mind through special methods including dark magic and magic stones.
But now, the magic stone was broken, Kelliark was tied to a maintenance device, and due to the rampage, Veradin's body and flesh were injured, making it impossible to do so.
In the past, when Veradin first confessed about his mind manipulation, Jin thought it was merely because Zipfel wanted to groom Veradin into a suitable successor.
It didn't seem like that now.
"So you've lost all that power now."
Jin couldn't feel any magical power from Veradin. His current state was no longer that of a magician.

"Not just power, but there are some problems with my memory as well. I can't remember my brothers' names well, and I've forgotten a lot of magic. It's a side effect of the rampage. The power will definitely come back, but I can't be sure about the memory. As for the magic, well, I can just learn it again."
Veradin had lost much more memory than Jin thought.
Yet, the stories he had with the two people he cherished most, Jin and Dante, remained vividly in his mind.
"What on earth does Zipfel want to do by manipulating your mind and enhancing your magic?"

"Well, the only sure thing is that Sandra and I are some sort of experimental subjects. As you know, my sister is a biological golem, and I... I don't have any clues yet. As you said before, it wouldn't be to groom me as a successor. After all, my father is getting closer to immortality."
Everyone who participated in the Swordsman Palace had seen Kelliark becoming younger through the power of the magic stone. It didn't seem like Kelliark Zipfel would hand over the throne to Veradin.
Suddenly.
Jin came up with a hypothesis.
'Sandra Zipfel's physical abilities demonstrated in Gaipa Province far surpassed those of a typical magician. And Veradin is experiencing simultaneous mental manipulation and power enhancement...'
A powerful body with regenerative abilities and artificially enhanced magical power.
What if Zipfel's goal is to combine these two and create a biological weapon? Like the ultimate magic knights in old Runcandel...
Furthermore, Veradin has contracted with more than one deity at the same time. This was also more likely to be the result of an experiment, not simply because Veradin was a blessed wizard.
He didn't voice his thoughts. It made him feel like he was about to vomit.
"Anyway, I'm sorry. You and Dante have suffered a lot because of my family."
"It's not your fault."
"I'm a Zipfel. Looking at the way the world is going now, it seems like being born into it is an original sin."
"Stop making such gloomy remarks. They don't suit you. Dante has no intention of fighting with you, and he doesn't think you're at fault."
"Are you going to abandon our Radi?"
"That seems like a problem that requires some thought."
"Exactly, you just need to abandon Radi and live happily with me."
Jin snorted a quiet laugh at her words.
"Veradin, do you remember what we talked about during the Imperial Palace attack?"
- No matter what happens, as long as the three of us don't betray each other.
He remembered it clearly.

While unconscious in the maintenance device, those words Jin spoke at the Imperial Palace were the only signpost in Veradin's subconscious. Just like how Ron, Dante, and Jin didn't lose their way in the chaos of the Imperial Palace.
"Of course. If it weren't for those words, I wouldn't have come here."
"Then it's settled."
"I don't know what you're talking about, but include me too."
"We're talking about betraying Zipfel."
"If you swear to formally marry me, I'll do it, no matter what."
In fact, Sandra had never done anything harmful to Jin. And she had already made up her mind to join in purifying Zipfel with Veradin.
Only because she thought Jin would like it more. Obviously, Jin didn't trust Sandra yet, but she would never harm Jin voluntarily.

"Dante will be here soon, have a drink and go back. When you return, say there were survivors of Hister here. That should be enough for Zipfel's leadership not to think they got nothing. It's like turning suspicion into certainty."
"No, no. You have to go on a date with me, Jin. You promised, didn't you?"
"I'd appreciate it if you thought of it as the four of us going on a date, Sandra Zipfel. There was no promise."
About an hour later, Dante arrived at the Litra Tea House. Seeing Veradin, Dante silently hugged him for a long time.
And when the tea house quieted down again after the drinking session ended, Jin and Valeria stayed behind to examine the record window together.
"We can't confirm with record magic whether Veradin Zipfel's claim that his mind wasn't manipulated is true or false."
Valeria said.
Instead, the record window clearly revealed one thing that remained at the Litra Tea House today.
<Veradin Zipfel's resolve to not betray Jin Runcandel and Dante Hairan became even stronger here.>
